descriptions.w3d_logic_type_get_800c4e78: Returns the global type record of a logic class.
descriptions.w3d_logic_unlink_800c4e84: Removes an entity from its logic class instance list and decrements the instance count.
descriptions.w3d_logic_create_800c4ec8: Allocates and constructs an entity of a logic class, then registers it in the class instance list.
descriptions.w3d_logic_release_800c4f28: Drops one reference to a logic entity; at zero it unlinks the entity and runs its deleting destructor.
descriptions.w3d_logic_retain_800c4f84: Adds one reference to a logic entity and returns the previous count.
descriptions.w3d_logic_construct_800c4f9c: Constructor of the slot pool: sizes the id vector to 128, reserves the busy list, numbers the ids and clears all 128 slots.
descriptions.w3d_logic_destroy_800c5064: Destructor of the slot pool: frees every occupied slot, empties both id vectors and clears the live-instance pointer.
descriptions.w3d_logic_handle_800c5100: Message handler: attach runs the base handler then a setup hook, detach runs a hook; other messages go to the base handler.
descriptions.w3d_logic_hook_800c539c: Empty hook of a logic class that does nothing.
descriptions.w3d_pool_free_800c58a8: Frees one pool slot: returns its storage to the heap, deletes the slot item and clears the table entry.
descriptions.w3d_logic_type_get_800c5fdc: Returns the global type record of a logic class.
descriptions.w3d_logic_unlink_800c5fe8: Removes an entity from its logic class instance list and decrements the instance count.
descriptions.w3d_logic_create_800c602c: Allocates and constructs an entity of a logic class, then registers it in the class instance list.
descriptions.w3d_logic_release_800c608c: Drops one reference to a logic entity; at zero it unlinks the entity and runs its deleting destructor.
descriptions.w3d_logic_retain_800c60e8: Adds one reference to a logic entity and returns the previous count.
descriptions.w3d_logic_construct_800c62dc: Constructor of the movie player entity: runs the logic base constructor, clears eight held slots and initialises its name string.
descriptions.w3d_logic_destroy_800c6344: Destructor of the movie player entity: frees its name string, releases eight held objects and runs the base destructor.
descriptions.w3d_movie_detach_800c6640: Detach hook of the movie player: stops any playing movie.
descriptions.w3d_movie_play_named_800c6660: Resolves a movie name to a file for the current TV format and starts playing it.
descriptions.w3d_movie_update_800c6878: Updates the playing movie and stops it, posting a finished message, once the player leaves its playing states.
descriptions.w3d_movie_stop_800c6920: Stops and releases the playing movie, posts a finished message and redraws the screen twice with display flags adjusted.
descriptions.w3d_movie_shutdown_800c6b50: Stops playback, deletes the movie player object and clears the live-instance pointer.
